hypothesis: The live ONNX policy fails because every UE Physics Control is capped at approximately 50 N*m while the exact ProtoMotions SMPL checkpoint used 500 N*m implicit-PD effort limits. Raising only the UE torque ceiling tenfold from the first policy target write will improve or restore standing without changing targets, drive frequency, damping, mapping, or timing.

authoritative_source.unit_derivation: Unreal uses centimeters: 1 N*m = 10,000 kg*cm^2/s^2, so 500,000 engine torque units is approximately 50 N*m and 5,000,000 is approximately 500 N*m.

single_changed_variable: Physics Control MaxTorqueMultiplier from first standing-policy state onward.

locked_configuration.action_axis: observation-parent-bind mesh-component axis from first policy

validity_gates: Same clean behavior commit and reused binary.
First-policy snapshot including raw model output is byte-identical.
All conditioned actions and target traces before torque application are identical.
Control arm publishes multiplier 1.0; experimental arm publishes 10.0 for all 21 controls.
Target readback is 1.0 in both arms.
support: Validity gates pass and the checkpoint ceiling strictly improves the failed-criterion set, time to collapse, and all major velocity/tilt maxima, or passes the locked hold.
falsification: Validity gates pass but the checkpoint ceiling is neutral or worsens standing, ruling out the low ceiling as the remaining sufficient cause.
next_if_falsified: Implement the exact checkpoint per-family force-PD Kp/Kd profile or an inertia-derived acceleration-mode equivalent, keeping the validated torque ceiling and all semantic mappings fixed.
